notes: Power Signatures, big upgrade: (1) reliable analysis - a steady load (e.g. a charge) now reads as a healthy steady draw instead of a false 'boot-loop'; surge detection only counts real current swings, not meter ripple, and voltage-sag can't be faked by PD steps. (2) New live stats: peak/avg power, min-V under load, ripple, and energy (mAh/Wh) so it doubles as a charge logger. (3) New Power-Delivery profile: live PD level + a negotiation timeline (5/9/12/15/20 V steps) with a drop-back-to-5V warning. (4) Crisp HiDPI graph - no more fuzzy lines/text when maximised.
